name: Zipline
description: Self-hosted file and screenshot sharing server with a web dashboard and short links.

envVars.description: Application secret used to sign sessions

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://zipline:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/zipline"
      CORE_SECRET: {{env.CORE_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/uploads:/zipline/uploads
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: zipline
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: zipline
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
